name: Natural Person Identification 5
definition: Identifies a natural person through identification number, name and domicile.

PersonName.name: Person Name
PersonName.definition: Name of the natural person.||Usage: the complete name, including first name, last name, and where applicable according to the regulation, middle name and surname.

NPI.name: NPI
NPI.definition: Natural person is identified through the natural person identifier.

AlternateIdentification.name: Alternate Identification
AlternateIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the natural person.

EntitySize.name: Entity Size
EntitySize.definition: Size of the entity according to a taxonomy defined in a regulation.

Sector.name: Sector
Sector.definition: The industry sector(s) of the economic activities of the natural person.
